mdRunbook.approval.enabled.markdownDescription: Proposed cells (fence `proposed`) are skipped until a human approves them. **Turning this off is insecure**: proposed cells, including ones written by an assistant, then run like any other cell.

mdRunbook.approval.resetOnEdit.markdownDescription: An approved cell whose code changed since it was approved needs approval again.

mdRunbook.approval.trustFileApprovals.markdownDescription: Honour `approved-by=` stamps that came with the file (approved by a colleague, or written by anything that can edit the file). When off, a cell must have been approved on this machine (same code) before it runs.

mdRunbook.approval.userName.markdownDescription: Name recorded as `approved-by=`. Empty = your OS user name.

mdRunbook.approval.policy.enabled.markdownDescription: Check cells proposed by an assistant (`by=`) against the command policy before they can be approved. When off, they are approved with one click.

mdRunbook.approval.policyFile.markdownDescription: Command policy file. Empty = the nearest `.md-runbook-policy.json` next to the runbook or in a parent folder up to the workspace folder; built-in policy if there is none. `${workspaceFolder}` is expanded; relative paths are relative to the workspace folder.

mdRunbook.approval.readOnlyOnly.markdownDescription: Cells proposed by an assistant (`by=`) refuse to run unless `#mdRunbook.approval.readOnlyEnv#` is set, so they never run with your normal credentials.

mdRunbook.approval.readOnlyEnv.markdownDescription: Environment variables for cells proposed by an assistant (`by=`), e.g. `{ "KUBECONFIG": "${secret:KUBECONFIG_READONLY}" }`. `${secret:NAME}` reads a stored secret (**md-runbook: Set Secret**). They override everything else and are redacted from output.
